entities.summary: Robyn M. Denholm is an Australian business executive and former accountant who is chair of Tesla, Inc. In November 2018, Denholm was chosen by Elon Musk to succeed him as chair of Tesla. She previously served as chief financial officer of computer hardware manufacturer Juniper Networks and Australian telecommunications company Telstra. Prior to her appointment, she was relatively unknown in the United States. As of 2025, she had the highest remuneration of any public company chair in the United States.
